metaTitle: How Many Lumens for Camping Lights
description: Learn what lumens really measure and how bright camping lanterns and tent lights should be, with use-by-use guidance on color, runtime and red light.
directAnswer: Most camp jobs need far fewer lumens than the box suggests: 20 to 80 inside a tent, 100 to 300 at a table or camp kitchen, and rarely more than 600 from one lantern. Choose warm color, a dimmer and a red mode.
